description: Issue #195 (the planner half): a profile that declares `integration_baseline` now PLANS. Before this the same profile stopped at load_error (exit 6) before an issue was read, so `merge.mjs --integration-verify` could only have found the declaration in a hand-edited plan — the asymmetry #180 left behind and profile-contract.md §10.6 had to record (this Issue lands both halves at once instead). The property pinned here is the ECHO: merge reads plan.profile.integration_baseline and never opens the profile, so the echo is the whole channel. Diff this case against 45: the profile is `companions-absent` plus this one field, and the issue bytes are identical, so everything below `profile` is the same plan — the planner does not USE the field, it carries it.
